notes.title: 1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Added a patch today with a few tweaks:

- Fixed a bug where after being stalled, a charge attack would not return the ball.
- Tweaked timing of ball attack
- fixed the Crowd Death scoreboard, which wasn't updating
- Bot behavior tweaked - given a few more behaviors, and reactions
- Visual tweaks(wobbly lasso, other little things)
- Removed Esc Key quits game (use the pause menu [P] to quit)
- Removed some developer functions
- Added additional info to "How to BALL"

notes.title: Laser Lasso BALL Release!
notes.content:
Laser Lasso BALL is officially released!  

Laser Lasso BALL is my first complete title.  It's been a surprisingly long road to getting such a minimal game complete, but I'm satisfied with the end result.

I hope it feels like a world that keeps on living once you shut down the game.

I've also added a couple features in the release build:
  - Master CPU difficulty : when you select this, the bot remains at its highest difficulty for 13 rounds.  See if you can beat it!
  - Switch Color Palette in main menu

notes.title: Pre-Release Early Access Update
notes.content:
It's been a while, but I've just added a new update of the game.  I'm very close to hitting the release version!

[b][h1]Single Player vs CPU mode added![/h1][/b]
  - BOTKILLER Achievement added for defeating the CPU
  - The bot gets progressively more difficult as you work your way through the roster, boosting is reacting speed and adding advanced tactics to its repertoire.

[b][h1]Keyboard Controls[/h1][/b]
 - now on at default
 - [b]Player 1[/b] : Arrow Keys and Ctrl
 - [b]Player 2[/b] : WASD and Space
 - Press P in game to Pause

[b][h1]Other Tweaks[/h1][/b]
- Crowd member collision more efficient so the game should run better on lower end systems
- New crowd members
- Particle FX to enhance feedback of certain events
- Kicking other players now cancels their attacks, making it a more valid tactic (try it!)
- New help screen
- Weapon Ball is more apparent
- More animations on player characters
- Toggle Palette Swap in main menu with (P) or (Select)


[b][h1]Danger Mode[/h1][/b]
 - danger mode is activated in rare occasions when the match appears imbalanced.  The crowd will attempt to rush the center of the arena, setting off deadly weapons.
